subtopics.title: Ratio basics
subtopics.zero: A ratio compares quantities in the same unit. 2:3 means for every 2 equal parts of the first quantity, there are 3 equal parts of the second.
subtopics.shortcut: Find the value of one part before actual shares.
subtopics.traps: Ratios cannot be added without aligning common terms.

subtopics.title: Direct and inverse proportion
subtopics.zero: Direct: both quantities change together. Inverse: one increases while the other decreases for the same total work.
subtopics.visual: More goods → more cost; more workers → fewer days
subtopics.rule: Direct x/y constant; inverse xy constant

examples.question: 8 machines make a batch in 15 hours. 12 machines?

subtopics.shortcut: Ask 'same direction or opposite direction?' before calculating.
subtopics.traps: Workers and days are inverse only when efficiency is equal.
